meta.description: Joins meshes into one, like the body from hyphae_to_mesh with the gills of lamellae and the veil of membrane. The groups of each mesh are numbered after those of the meshes before it, and the colors stay.

a.description: A mesh, its groups come first.

b.description: Another mesh, its groups are numbered after those of a.

c.description: Another mesh, its groups are numbered after those of a and b.

d.description: Another mesh, its groups are numbered after those of a, b and c.
